outcomes.changedWhat: Reduced take_profit_pct from 4.0 to 2.5; reduced max_hold_bars from 64 to 48; reduced expected_holding_time_min from 240 to 180. Kept entry logic identical.

outcomes.name: rsi-dip-btc-eth-only
outcomes.changedWhat: Reduced pairs list from 8 to 2: only BTC-EUR and ETH-EUR. All other parameters identical to parent.
outcomes.why: Per-pair analysis reveals BTC-EUR is the largest loser (-2.73 EUR, 16.7% winrate), while altcoins show inflated winrates on tiny samples (WLD, NEAR, XRP: 1–2 trades each, 100% winrate). This is classic overfitting. By concentrating on BTC and ETH (most liquid, lowest slippage, largest sample sizes), we reduce fee fragility and avoid false confidence from low-volume pairs. BTC and ETH together represent the core edge.
outcomes.expectedImprovement: Reduce slippage and fill-quality variance; improve OOS robustness by trading only pairs with sufficient liquidity and historical data. Expected OOS winrate >48%; net PnL >10 EUR; more consistent per-pair performance.
outcomes.failureCriteria: OOS net-negatief; combined BTC+ETH winrate <45%; trade count <8 (insufficient sample); robustness ratio <0.55; BTC-EUR still shows <30% winrate.
